The service has a visible sequence: accepted, on the way, in progress and completed. Details and a rating stay with the same booking. These customer screens use an isolated demo with sample records.

Customers book and follow their wash. Washers apply, take jobs and see their earnings. The operations team manages users, payments, quality and support. Each role has a different job within the same product.

Los clientes reservan y siguen su lavado. Los lavadores se postulan, toman servicios y consultan sus ganancias. El equipo operativo administra usuarios, pagos, calidad y soporte. Cada rol tiene una tarea distinta dentro del mismo producto.

Bright blue, dimensional illustrations and simple controls make a practical service feel approachable. The design system gives that personality a repeatable form, from the palette to the states of every field and button.

El azul intenso, las ilustraciones con volumen y los controles sencillos hacen cercana una tarea cotidiana. El sistema de diseño permite repetir esa personalidad, desde la paleta hasta los estados de cada campo y botón.
